rows: The body's configuration changes before animation: scattered bones → assembled body → living body
This is a **two-stage transformation**, not simply activation with structure unchanged
Completed versus continuing prophecy compares different subjects; it is not one group's temporal state changing into the other's
Preserve **parallel activity histories**, not a fabricated transition
The readings can involve different consonantal spellings as well as vocalization: שנים / שניים
A vacated position and its replacement must retain their source-specific heavenly addresses; different occupants do not establish identical offices
Test **seat continuity versus authority succession**, rather than assume both
